description.text: Ten single hybrid attacks (0.66 or 1.19 each), grants [Haste], [Attach Earth] and [Burst Mode] to the user

description.name: Attach Earth
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Earth damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Earth resistance +20%

description.name: Burst Mode
description.text: Replaces the Attack and Defend commands, ATK, DEF, MAG, RES, MND, ACC and EVA +20%, SPD +10%
